scope: Isolierter Browser mit nativer Empfangswarteschlange. Vorbereitungsdiagnosen werden bewusst zurückgehalten und mit veraltetem Bedarf beantwortet. Punktmeldungen enthalten den auf dem Server berechneten Zustand; keine Live-Dienste.
checks: The successor marker and point change in the same native score handler
The green field is rendered while the separate server diagnosis is still unanswered
A delayed negative diagnosis cannot remove the current positive point flag
Correcting the threshold point clears green in the same handler
A delayed positive diagnosis cannot re-enable the corrected field
A point with unchanged successor state makes no marker attribute changes
A successor-only snapshot patches the marker without rebuilding names or scores
Older score messages clear stale flags and retain diagnostic compatibility
All native messages receive successful presentation receipts after their UI work
Point and marker handlers meet the small-update processing budget
